flatten_grid_list: flatten a list of torch grid tensors into a single 2D tensor and return grid sizes
unflatten_grid_tensor: unflatten a 2D tensor back into a tuple of grid tensors using provided grid sizes
pad_feature_to_block_size: pad a feature tensor to a multiple of the specified block size using zero padding
check_grid_shapes: validate that grid tensors and grid sizes are consistent and compatible with each other
process_and_flatten_grid: process and flatten grid and color grid tensors into unified 2D tensor form with sizes
